name: opencode Launcher
author: SmartALB
description: Open opencode in a project directory, with the model chosen before it starts. The model travels as a flag; your opencode.json is never written to.

barWidget.description: Open opencode in a project directory with a chosen model

schema.label: Next to the bar icon
schema.description: The model belongs to the project row, so a single pill cannot report it truthfully. It shows the icon, optionally with the number of opencode windows currently open.

schema.label: Recent projects
schema.description: How many directories from past opencode sessions to list below your pinned ones. 0 turns them off.

schema.label: Refresh the model list after
schema.description: Hours before the cached model list is fetched again. The refresh button in the panel does it on demand.

schema.label: Ask before a second window
schema.description: Shift+Enter opens a second window for a project that is already running. Off is the fast path the bar is for.
